extension.description: Complete 105-path media format pack: 31 sourced authentic mark paths and 74 original technical glyphs. Original diagrams identify formats, resolutions, ratios and channel counts; they are not official brand logos. Restricted VP8, VP9 and Xvid logos are not included. Mixed licenses and trademark restrictions apply. Select in Skin settings > Artwork > Media icon pack.
